func source_cut_reject(code, site, detail = null):
	source_diagnostic(site, code, {"control": source_cut_control(), "detail": detail, "private_connections": source_control_rows(self, "source_idle_cut_ready"), "tree_connections": source_control_rows(get_tree(), "idle_frame")})
	fail(code, site)
	get_tree().quit(2)
	return false

func endCombat():
	NativeRandomObserver.entry("Core/Game.gd::endCombat", self, {})
	if fightEnded:
		var observer7_return_0 = null
		NativeRandomObserver.leave("Core/Game.gd::endCombat", self, observer7_return_0, "return_explicit")
		return
	
	Engine.time_scale = 1
	fightEnded = true
	triesBeforeFight = tries
	
	if ( not loseNextRound and not loseNextRun and 
		(OPPONENT.curHealth <= 0 or winNextRun or winNextRound)):
		roundResults[curRound - 1] = RoundResult.Win
		wins += 1
		PLAYER.playSound(classResources[curClass].getWinRoundSound(), 4, 1.0, true)
		PLAYER.win()
		Sound.playSound(winSound)
		OPPONENT.lose()
	
	else:
		roundResults[curRound - 1] = RoundResult.Loss
		losses += 1
		tries = max(0, tries - 1)
		PLAYER.playSound(classResources[curClass].getLoseRoundSound(), 4, 1.0, true)
		OPPONENT.win()
		PLAYER.lose()
		Sound.playSound(loseSound, 3)
	
	print("Round ", curRound, " Battle ended with ", Util.enumToString(RoundResult, roundResults[curRound - 1]))
	
	call_deferred("combatEndDeferred")
	NativeRandomObserver.leave("Core/Game.gd::endCombat", self, null, "return_implicit")
